weeks.title: Course introduction, data, and evidence
weeks.focus: Describe a row, a unit, a target, and an evidence chain.

weeks.title: Features, targets, and leakage-safe splits
weeks.focus: Build a preprocessing pipeline and inspect held-out classification errors.

weeks.title: Supervised learning: regression and classification
weeks.focus: Choose a baseline and distinguish continuous from categorical targets.

weeks.title: No class — Teachers’ Day holiday
weeks.focus: Follow the current semester calendar; no new in-class practice.

weeks.title: Evaluation, validation, and overfitting
weeks.focus: Explain precision, recall, specificity, thresholds, and validation. Homework milestone: ML Problem Brief.

weeks.title: Unsupervised learning and representation
weeks.focus: Interpret PCA and clusters while separating geometry from physical meaning.

weeks.title: Sequences → LSTM → Attention → Transformer
weeks.focus: Trace LSTM memory, compute attention, and train/test a tiny causal Transformer across three one-hour modules.

weeks.title: No class — observed Retrocession Day holiday
weeks.focus: Consolidate the sequence notebooks; no new in-class practice.

weeks.title: ML reliability, shift, and error analysis
weeks.focus: Stress-test model assumptions and report subgroup failures.

weeks.title: Reproducible ML workflow studio
weeks.focus: Rebuild a baseline from frozen data and split IDs. Homework milestone: ML Workflow.

weeks.title: Midterm written and oral examinations
weeks.focus: Explain project data, baseline, evaluation, limitations, and reproduction.

weeks.title: LLMs, bounded agents, and vibe coding
weeks.focus: Separate next-token generation from validated action execution.

weeks.title: Retrieval, source evidence, and structured knowledge
weeks.focus: Build a lexical retrieval baseline with source IDs and abstention.

weeks.title: Agent testing, failure cases, and oversight
weeks.focus: Enforce permissions, step budgets, and human review. Homework milestone: Final Agent Plan.

weeks.title: Agent Studio I: build a bounded workflow
weeks.focus: Produce traceable descriptive results with a validated input schema.

weeks.title: Agent Studio II: evaluation and demo rehearsal
weeks.focus: Compare candidates using reference cases and recorded failures. Homework milestone: Demo Readiness.

weeks.title: Project integration and oral-exam preparation
weeks.focus: Package data identity, code, result cards, limitations, and AI-use disclosure.

weeks.title: Final written and oral examinations
weeks.focus: Defend the final project with a reproducible evidence package.
